items.summary: waLBerla LB/EK GPU backend (60 generated CUDA.cu lattice-Boltzmann + electrokinetics + reaction kernels in src/walberla_bridge) scoped out via ESPRESSO_BUILD_WITH_WALBERLA=OFF. waLBerla is a separate upstream with its own CUDA gpu backend; porting it means HIP-ifying walberla::gpu itself.
